GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 383.7 (4 Dec 45) CIS
(SCAPIN - 387)
APO 500
4 December 1945
MEMORANDUM FOR : THE IMPERIAL JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Apprehension of Commander HATAKEYAMA, Kunito and Lieutenant Commander NAKAGAWA, Kenichi.
1. The Imperial Japanese Government will apprehend and deliver to the authorities of the Sugamo Prison Camp, Commander HATAKEYAMA, Kunito, attached to Naval Department, Tokyo, and Lieutenant Commander NAKAGAWA Kenichi, retired, after the completion of court-martial trial which is reported to be in progress concerning the above two officers.
2. It is directed that the Imperial Japanese Government furnish this headquarters with complete translations in English of all proceedings of the court, including evidence under oath, in the above case.
The translations should be forwarded in triplicate.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
H.W.ALLEN,
Colonel, A.G.D.,
Asst Adjutant General.
